unresolved_gaps: No located Lensa evaluation establishes recurring factual and reasoning failures under clearly defined, appropriate tasks. Unwanted sexualization alone does not establish those categories.
The ChatGPT evidence establishes recurring incorrect answers and susceptibility to fabrication, but does not separately measure reasoning-error frequency.
The DALL-E 2 benchmark measures task ratings rather than a general factual-error or hallucination rate. Its exact testing dates are not specified in the passages read.
The meaning of factual error and hallucination for stylized image generation remains consequential to the assessment.
